title: Universal Even-Odd Coherent-Error Parity Dichotomy, Swap-Point Criticality, and Exact-Q Decoding Certificates for CSS Quantum Codes
abstract: Uniform coherent Z-rotations U(theta) = bigotimes_{j=1}^n exp(i theta Z_j) induce non-Pauli logical channels whose optimal recovery and finite-size scaling differ sharply from Pauli-twirled stochastic phase-flip noise. Extending the recent surface-code parity analysis of Dai, Wan, Dai, and Zhu (arXiv:2611.13098, 2026), we establish three general structural theorems for arbitrary [[n, 1, d]] Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes, formalize their algebraic core in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0, 18 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), and construct an exact-Q certificate verifier (COHERENT-CSS-CERT-1.0) free of floating-point trust. First, for every [[n, 1, d]] CSS code whose Z-stabilizers have even Hamming weight, we prove a Universal Even-Odd Parity Dichotomy: when |L_Z| is odd, every syndrome Kraus operator is proportional to a pure logical Z_L-rotation, so syndrome-conditioned unitary recovery achieves exact unit entanglement fidelity F_e^{CPTP}(theta) = 1 for all theta in [0, pi/2]; when |L_Z| is even, every syndrome Kraus operator is Hermitian up to phase, and the exact trace-norm identity (|a+b| + |a-b|)^2 = 4 max(a^2, b^2) forces maximum-likelihood Pauli decoding to attain the exact global CPTP optimum F_e^{Pauli}(theta) = F_e^{CPTP}(theta) over all quantum channels. Second, using exact F_2 harmonic analysis on the self-orthogonal subcode K_Z = S_Z cap S_Z^perp, we prove a Complete 0-1 Swap-Point Binary Law: at theta = pi/4, F_e^{Pauli}(pi/4) takes only two values across all [[n, 1, d]] CSS codes -- 1/2 iff L_Z perp K_Z (equivalently (L_X + S_X) cap S_Z = empty), and 1 iff there exists g* in K_Z with |L_Z cap g*| = 1 (mod 2). Third, as an immediate topological corollary, rotating an even-d rotated surface code patch by 90 degrees (X-majority vs. Z-majority check orientation) flips its theta = pi/4 logical fidelity from complete collapse (1/2) to complete coherent immunity (1), witnessed explicitly by the left-boundary column stabilizer g* = prod_{j=0}^{d/2-1} Z_{(2j,0)} Z_{(2j+1,0)} in K_Z. Exact-Q polynomial evaluation across 9 certified benchmark codes and a 129-code census (matching complex 2x2 SVD to 1.45e-14 and rejecting 37/37 adversarial forgery attacks) uncovers exact all-angle coherent-twirled cancellation on X-majority d=2 surface codes, 113.26x coherent infidelity suppression on Shor [[9,1,3]] at p = sin^2(theta) = 1/5 (reaching exact zero infidelity F_e^{Pauli}(1/4) = 1 at theta = pi/6), and a strict coherent penalty (F_e^{Pauli} < F_e^{twirl}) on doubly-even Quantum Reed-Muller [[15,1,3]].
